Tell_us_a_little_about_yourself!:
I was first introduced to CPL through a former teammate of mine at Marin Rowing Association, Aliya Greenberg, whose experience immediately made me curious to learn more. As I have thought deeply about the kind of work I want to pursue, I realized I thrive in environments that blend qualitative judgment with quantitative rigor.

I am a prospective history and economics major, and always enjoyed approaching problems from multiple angles, thinking critically through reading and writing, then grounding those ideas in data and numbers. Wealth management naturally aligns with that balance, as it combines thoughtful asset allocation with a deep understanding of people, their goals, and their values.

Relationship-building and trust are especially important to me. On the crew team at Williams, trust is one of our three core values and guides everything we do as a team. I believe it’s foundational to any meaningful client relationship, particularly in the wealth management industry.

As a student-athlete, I have been surrounded by empowering female teammates, which has shaped the kind of network and culture I want in my future career. My mother was one of my first role models as a woman in the corporate world, and that influence led me to Girls Who Invest and to pitching a stock this fall through the Women in Investing Conference. Working alongside strong women, like Lisa Cregan, genuinely motivates me more than anything in this world.
